findings.claim: The rewritten 'resting on a prop top or car roof' branch of visualPose has no gate or test that runs it. This is the not-airborne case where the hull height y < car.y, so pose.y = car.y and pose.pitch = 0. Tonight's C042 rewrote it from a ternary returning a fresh object into two separate ternary writes to the module scratch `pose`, so nothing pins the change.
findings.evidence: Changed lines 190-191: `pose.y = y >= car.y ? y : car.y;` / `pose.pitch = y >= car.y ? pitch : 0;` (was `return y >= car.y ? { y, pitch } : { y: car.y, pitch: 0 };`). This branch is only reached through carView/carViews while a non-airborne car sits on a prop or roof (updateVertical car.ts:596-619 sets car.y = restingTop). The only test that puts a car on a prop top is tests/sim/car.test.ts:307 'coming down onto a prop, lands on its top…', and it checks CarState via run()/stepCars, never carView. tests/sim/push-out.test.ts imports only stepCars. The carView/carViews callers in tests (ramp-pose, ramp-lip-roll, race, determinism, replay, countdown-*) drive on ground or ramps. G3 compares only the end-state views of 5 replays, and none of them ends on a prop (prop-collision stops at GO+300 after bleeding speed against the bale side). G2 compares lap times, which never read carView. P1/P2 pose no car on a prop. A slip such as swapping the arms of line 191 would pass every gate.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a new test file, e.g. tests/sim/car-pose-prop-top.test.ts, that reuses the car.test.ts:307 setup: a hay bale at (0,0) on stripTrack, a car moving east at x=-2, airborne=true, y=1.5. Step it with stepCars, and on each tick where `c.y === PROP_COLLIDER_TOP && !c.airborne`, assert `carView(c, track).y === PROP_COLLIDER_TOP` and `carView(c, track).pitch === 0`. Also assert this happened on at least one tick. carView is the public seam already exported from src/sim/car.ts.

checked.how: Runs on every carViews call: src/sim/world.ts:121-122 → G3 runReplay end states (gates.md: 5 replays exact vs main), tests/sim/replay.test.ts:139, race.test.ts:38-56, determinism.test.ts, ramp-pose.test.ts:34. Covered.

tests/sim/ramp-pose.test.ts 'never clips into the ramp… at full speed' asserts views.some(v=>v.airborne) and clip depth < 1e-6 on every tick via carViews; ramp-lip-roll.test.ts also runs it. Executed (invariant-checked, not bit-pinned against main).
ramp-pose.test.ts checks max pitch ≈ atan2(1,5) and views[0].pitch === 0, and the crawl and reverse cases; ramp-lip-roll.test.ts rolls off the lip. Executed.
Grep for carView in tests/sim/push-out.test.ts: none. car.test.ts:307 rests on a bale but never calls carView. No replay ends on a prop. Not executed → F1.

Called by both visualPose branches, so ramp-pose/ramp-lip-roll run the lip/foot pushes on the Dust Bowl Classic ramp. The length=0 reset runs on every call. Same float order as main per diff. G3 exact.

Grep of every import from render/index.ts in tests/ and harness/: all names they use (incl. countdownOffsetEast, CarLivery, PlacedProp, RaceScene) are still exported. Compile-time only, checked by G1 typecheck (716/716 pass).
